records.issue_text: app/assets/javascripts/discourse/adapters/rest.js.es6:22 — type.replace('_', '-')` only replaces the first underscore, so `basePath` would misclassify any admin model type name containing more than one underscore as non-admin
records.rationale: In `rest.js.es6`, `basePath(store, type)` now normalizes the type via `type.replace('_', '-')` before checking `ADMIN_MODELS`. In JavaScript, `String#replace` without a global regex only replaces the first underscore, so a type like `some_admin_model` would become `some-admin_model` and fail to match a fully-hyphenated entry in `ADMIN_MODELS`, causing the adapter to return "/" instead of "/admin/"
